profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Businessolver | CS@Mines BS/MS Graduate
profile.summary:
Passionate about software engineering and problem-solving, I recently earned my Master’s (Dec 2024) and Bachelor’s (Dec 2023) degrees in Computer Science from Colorado School of Mines. With experience in full-stack development, cloud computing, and software testing, I thrive in collaborative, fast-paced environments, building efficient, scalable solutions.

As a Software Engineer at Businessolver, I have contributed to the Eligibility and Enrollment and Payroll and Billing domains, leveraging Java, React, and Oracle SQL, while ensuring robust code quality with JUnit and testNG.

With experience in AGILE development, cloud security, and macOS app development, I’m always eager to learn, build, and innovate. Open to new opportunities—let’s connect!

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Collaborate within a SCRUM team to enhance Businessolver’s Eligibility and Enrollment platform using AGILE methodologies.

Develop and maintain full-stack features with a Java backend, React and XSL-based frontend, and Oracle SQL database.

Conduct rigorous testing with JUnit and TestNG to increase code coverage and ensure high-quality software delivery.

positions.title: Barista
positions.description:
Take customer orders and fulfill through POS
• Log deliveries and stock in POS
• Create high-quality drinks catered to customer’s needs and desires

positions.title: CS@Mines Field Session - Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Designed and built a full-stack healthcare attestation portal using Java, Spring Boot, React, Node.js, and MySQL.

Integrated Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services to extract and validate healthcare provider data.

Followed AGILE principles, held weekly progress meetings, and presented project milestones to senior engineers.
positions.insights: Full-Stack Development, Cloud Computing and +3 skills

positions.title: In Store Shopper / Cashier
positions.description: Fulfilled orders submitted by customers in a timely and high-quality manner and ensured drop off of orders to customers. Used POS system to check out customers at both registers and self check out, and maintained quality customer service and support.
